message: Forbidden raise in application function — handle locally with an explicit result type

evaluator_config.message_template: Forbidden raise in function '{name}' — handle locally with an explicit result type

rationale: Application logic must not transfer failures via raise. Language construction protocols (dunder methods such as __init__/__new__) may raise ValueError/TypeError per the data model. Process entrypoints (main, cli_entry, async_main, run_*) may raise after failed bootstrap. Property accessors follow fixed return contracts and are out of scope.
remediation: Catch failures within the function and convert them to a structured success/failure result (e.g. Result.failure / Result.success). Do not raise for normal application error paths.
